# BTicino C300X Integration v2.9.1

## 2026-11-24

[![Support me on Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/img/githubbutton_sm.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/oliver7557)

2.9.1 contains everything from 2.9.0 plus the fixes and additions below,
marked **New in 2.9.1**.

## Finding the station after an address change

When the station gets a new IPv4 address, for example from DHCP, Home Assistant
follows it. The agent announces itself again over mDNS once HA has not reached
it for 15 minutes, and reopens the announcement on an address change. HA moves
the entry only after the station at the new address proves that it knows the
saved token. HA sends it only a fresh random value; no token is ever sent to an
unproven address. When the station did not answer, HA checks again up to two
more times, 10 minutes apart. Entries with a host name or IPv6 address still
need **Reconfigure**. An agent restart also changes the mDNS announcement, so HA
reconnects without waiting for the scheduled renewal when multicast arrives.

## Station

- Send a quiet envelope notification with `data: {mode: led}`. It does not
  wake the screen, show a popup or play sound. Unread device memos keep their
  indicator when HA notices are dismissed.
- On supported Qt4 stations, **Settings > Home Assistant** offers HA feedback,
  SSH, reboot and agent removal even when HA is offline. Reboot and removal
  each require confirmation. The original touch-tone switch remains under General.
- The Alarm and Home Assistant buttons on the home page no longer stay hidden
  when their first reads after a start fail.
- New Display option **Home page buttons**: **Stock** (de **Werkseinstellung**)
  shows Alarm and Home Assistant only when needed, among the station's own
  buttons. After the agent update most stations use this layout; the Display
  form shows which one yours uses. Choose **Fixed side by side** to keep the
  previous pair. Based on a fix by Dave in PR #126, thanks!
- **New in 2.9.1:** Text memos written from Home Assistant are saved by the
  station itself. They show on the display at once, without a GUI restart, the
  memo badge counts them correctly, and they can be deleted on the station and
  from HA.
- **New in 2.9.1:** Memos deleted from HA disappear from the display without a
  GUI restart. A delete the station refuses fails at once instead of timing out.

## Notifications

- **New in 2.9.1:** Notify takes three switches, `display`, `tts` and `led`,
  in any combination. With `display` and `tts` the message is spoken instead of
  the tone. With the switches, only notices with `led` light the message LED.
  `mode` keeps working; `mode: both` now drops the tone instead of refusing
  `sound_duration`.
- **New in 2.9.1:** Refused display notifications show a translated message.

## Camera and card

- Adjust brightness, contrast and colour saturation from the doorbell card
  or the `bticino_c300x.camera_picture` action. Opening the sliders during a
  Ring Call does not answer it. On-demand sliders appear shortly after live
  video starts: on firmware 1.7.19 (tested on a station), on 2.0.2 with either
  video decoder and on 3.0.6 on its TVP5150 boards (checked offline only). A
  setting the station does not confirm is put back, and the card says why.
  Changes last until the video ends. The panel is see-through, so the picture
  stays visible while adjusting. Existing snapshots and recordings are
  unchanged.
- The card is as tall as its picture, and the enlarged snapshot preview fits on
  screen. Playback controls no longer sit on a dark bar. **New in 2.9.1:** the
  play, mute and volume controls hide while the picture sliders panel is open.
- **New in 2.9.1:** A stream the browser refuses to play with sound starts
  muted, and the card says to tap it for sound.
- Camera quality offers matching snapshot sizes, including on return to factory
  resolution.
- Direct RTSP viewers can recover after a partial packet write during short
  WiFi stalls. Other clients do not wait for the slow client to catch up.
- CPU usage, device temperature and the audio codec selector are enabled by
  default for new entities when supported. Enabling the selector does not change
  the codec.

## Fixed

- Removing the agent restores the station's original call-routing program before
  deleting its backup. Since 1.2.1 it left the patched program without an
  original copy when the HA media user was enabled.
- A memo or video-message delete could be answered with an error although it
  succeeded.
- From this agent on, updates refuse to start while `/` is already writable
  (`update_root_already_writable`) and report a failed return to read-only
  separately. Firmware detection is consistent across capabilities and self-test.
- After the agent loses HA's display registration, HA registers again at once,
  so unread snapshot notices reach the station.
- The SSH switch shows off once SSH is stopped, even with a session still open.
- Writing a text memo with an agent that cannot do it shows a readable message.
- With the fixed side-by-side buttons, the station's own buttons no longer
  slide off screen next to Quick actions (#119) or on stations that show only
  Memo and Settings, and a hidden Alarm button keeps its place empty.

**New in 2.9.1:**

- All display pages follow a changed `listen.uiPort`; port 8090 is no longer
  needed. Reapply the Display patch after a port change.
- A Display patch write past its deadline gets 15 s to put the display back
  instead of being killed at once. A write cut off by a power loss is finished
  at the next agent start; one the agent cannot finish shows up in Repairs.
- Opening the station's Memo page could delete station memos when the agent's
  memo list was incomplete.
- After the HA media user patched the call-routing program, `/` could stay
  writable and agent updates were refused until a reboot.
- When the station's display answers a ring, HA keeps the camera on external
  media for the whole display call (up to 65 s). After a busy answer from the
  station, the agent waits up to 65 s, or until that call ends, before calling
  it again.
- When HA answers a ring, the card no longer turns busy without a picture. A
  failed stream start no longer leaves the card busy, and an answered ring
  keeps its hang-up button after a reload.
- The agent restart after an update waits for the old agent, so the new one
  no longer fails to start.
- A failed removal starts the agent again. Removal takes only the agent's
  rules out of the firewall scripts.
- An update cut off by a power loss no longer blocks later updates.
- Idle RTSP connections no longer lock HA out of the live stream.
- The MQTT bridge reconnects after a silent broker and skips oversized
  messages.
- A clock step after boot no longer trips the CPU watchdog.
- With **Keep the page open on screen standby**, the Alarm and HA pages no
  longer stay frozen after the screen wakes.
- Smaller fixes for HA hosts without IPv6, the single-area Alarmo fallback,
  cross-site API requests, the card editor focus and service calls without
  `entry_id`.

## Settings and documentation

The Display option **Stay on the page after an action** is renamed **Keep the
page open on screen standby**, which is what it always did. Older entries that
never saved it now show it on, as the display applies it. The documentation is
reorganised into fewer, task-based pages.

## Upgrade

The agent-update Repair installs the 2.9.1 agent together with its display
files. The settings page requires the optional Display patch. Ring Call picture
controls need the core GUI patch; on-demand controls use the updated agent's
source readback instead.
